items.text: We should remember the words of the late Rep. Oberstar- “I urge you not to trade off the lifestyles, livelihoods, & legitimate desires of the people of NE MN for equitable treatment in favor of the vague & ill-defined interests of other constituencies far removed from the BWCA.” https://t.co/Yjd5sNv7ia

I introduced the bipartisan Small Business Payment for Performance Act along with @RepVeasey @RepScottPeters & @RepBrianFitz to require fair treatment of small construction contractors by federal agencies during the procurement process. Read more here: https://t.co/pxDJwsT7KB

It’s important veterans get the timely & quality healthcare they deserve. That’s why I voted for the Senate version of the PACT Act. This bipartisan bill will improve VA services for toxic-exposed veterans without overwhelming the VA system, delaying care or disrupting services.

Today I met with the Voyageurs National Park Clean Water Joint Powers Board to discuss the important work they do to improve wastewater treatment in the region. Thanks for the update! https://t.co/vYyb06eRWX

It’s great to see Maj. Katie Lunning of the MN Air National Guard be awarded the Distinguished Flying Cross for her heroic actions rescuing & providing care for patients after the attack at the Kabul airport in 2021. Minnesotans thank you for your service.

I enjoyed meeting with members of the Minnesota @VFWHQ in Washington today to discuss their priorities including ensuring service members and veterans have access to timely and high-quality healthcare. https://t.co/Il1TQ9AtS5

The ATF's pistol brace rule is an attack on law-abiding gun owners. I just voted to nullify this rule to protect the 2nd amendment rights of law-abiding citizens, particularly our wounded veterans who rely on pistol braces to exercise their 2A rights.

I was honored to receive a Champion of Healthcare Innovation award from @HealthInFocus.  I am proud to support patient-centered medical progress and am working in D.C. to expand healthcare technology. https://t.co/Ma0sx5HRDo
Today I toured Ely-Bloomenson Community Hospital along with CEO Patti Banks to meet with staff and hear about challenges faced by our rural hospitals. Thank you for the visit! https://t.co/V9859891oS

Visited Essentia Health in Duluth and witnessed firsthand the incredible work our healthcare professionals are doing for our communities. Ensuring access to quality and caring healthcare in rural areas is vital for the well-being of our area of Minnesota. https://t.co/gnrDPyCODW

As a former police officer, I've witnessed the heart-wrenching aftermath of suicide and the profound impact it has on families and communities. Let's prioritize mental health, offer support, and always remind each other that there is hope. Reach out. Speak up. https://t.co/qazMQZvn6q

I was able to visit the Cirrus Innovation Center & Northland Psychological Services this week. It's incredible to see cutting-edge aviation advancements and dedicated mental health care right here in #MN08! https://t.co/mWqCJuHYoZ

Today, on #NationalRuralHealthDay, I want to extend my deepest gratitude to our rural healthcare workers. Your unwavering commitment to serving our communities, often under challenging conditions, exemplifies the best of American resilience and dedication. https://t.co/d0ExWXRK35
I am incredibly grateful to the first responders who helped bring these people to safety! During this unseasonably warm weather, I urge everyone to exercise caution around the ice.

It’s unacceptable that Secretary Austin kept his medical crisis a secret.

This put America’s national security at risk, and no one in the Biden Administration knew about it.

The Biden Administration is asleep at the wheel and we should all be concerned. https://t.co/7IR0fCbqrx

Today, I am voting to protect Americans with disabilities and chronic health conditions from life-threatening discrimination in healthcare. 

Every American deserves to receive quality care. https://t.co/VUETs30wD1

Come meet with my staff at our upcoming mobile office hours! Need help navigating the IRS, Social Security, Medicare, veterans’ benefits, and other federal programs? We are here to serve you! https://t.co/R2gj7rO8qv

I'm calling on Mary Moriarty to resign in disgrace for this abuse of power. As a former law enforcement officer, I stand with Trooper Ryan Londregan and all of Minnesota’s heroic law enforcement officers who have faced unfair treatment at the hands of DFL leaders.

Biden is slashing Medicare Advantage for 33 million American seniors.

This cut will impact nearly 80,000 seniors living in #MN08, costing them an extra $400 per year.

Devastating news for seniors who are already struggling under record-high inflation. https://t.co/5ENskUEAm4

I travelled to Silver Bay to meet with Mayor Wade LeBlanc & discuss the $1.75 million in federal funding I helped deliver to make much needed improvements to their water treatment facility. 

These improvements are vital to ensuring safe and reliable water for the city’s users! https://t.co/8lon7shXBx

I recently met with Dr. Gervais to discuss the VA’s new fee schedule, which threatens our primary auditory health care provider for veterans in NE and NC Minnesota. We must protect our veterans' access to essential care! https://t.co/q7eFEIgAqd

It was great to visit the Mahnomen Hospital. Access to quality medical care in rural Minnesota isn't just a luxury—it's a lifeline. We must ensure our rural communities have the resources they need to thrive. https://t.co/YKFWXLRqGo

September is Suicide Prevention Month. As a 23-year police officer, I know first hand the devastating effects of suicide. Every conversation about mental health can be a lifeline. Let's break the stigma and show that no one is alone in their struggles. https://t.co/rkqTlex2oW

Honored to have been able to speak at the 6th Annual Veterans Suicide Prevention & Awareness Day in Duluth. We remember those we've lost and commit to supporting our veterans' mental health. Together, we can make a difference. https://t.co/vFKWTSN40C

Hurricane Helene has shut down a facility that supplies 60% of our nation’s IV fluids. Today, I sent a letter to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to gather more information on how they plan to mitigate this supply gap. https://t.co/rIp2nvj4P1
